name: Solace – therapy for refugees and asylum seekers
whoFor: Refugees and asylum seekers over 17 living in Kirklees or Calderdale.
gate: Is a refugee or asylum seeker
referralRoutes: Referral by a health professional or support organisation (online form)

selfReferral.note: A health professional or support organisation refers using Solace's online form. The person must agree to the referral.

projects.name: Trauma therapy for refugees
projects.overview: Talking therapy for refugees and asylum seekers who've lived through trauma, torture or trafficking, plus a weekly stress management group in Kirklees. Places are limited; they aim to see people within 4 months.

coachNotes: Demand is high and places are limited. Keep supporting the person while they wait.
